name: TinyTandem
summary:
Join Albo and Alba in a charming puzzle adventure built around teamwork, timing, and clever thinking.

In Tiny Tandem, you control two lovable companions who move together through a series of handcrafted challenges. What seems simple at first quickly becomes a test of coordination as rotating obstacles, moving hazards, and creative puzzle mechanics stand between you and the goal.
